releaseNotes:
## ✨ What's New

### 🧭 New Ways to Work
- Choose a mode when starting a chat, including a dedicated Coding workspace with a familiar editor-style layout.
- Work with files, a browser, terminals, Problems, side-by-side diffs, and board tasks from the Coding workspace.
- Create and refine agents in the new Agent Designer, with clearer configuration and access to their save folders.
- Coordinate multiple agents through a bounded multi-agent mode.

### 🎨 Design and Workflow Improvements
- Send design annotations to chat, use contextual review actions, and work with a refreshed notes pane.
- Edit workflows on a native designer canvas with clearer step labels and more consistent graph handling.
- Find and manage marketplace sources more easily with built-in source indicators and sorting.

## 🛠️ Improvements
- Preview Markdown and HTML files in Coding mode; previews stay available when switching tabs.
- Use multiple terminal tabs and a built-in browser tab in the Coding workspace.
- Enjoy more tailored workspace welcome screens, clearer chat controls, and richer scheduled-task execution details.
- Agent and skill selection, workflow library navigation, and the marketplace settings experience have been refined.

## 🐛 Bug Fixes
- Switching chats and retrying messages now better preserves attachments, streaming state, tool details, and session routing.
- Agent availability is refreshed before ACP prompts, and ACP runtimes are isolated by project root.
- Workspace HTML previews have been restored; file-preview state is preserved across tabs and reset between sessions.
- Selecting boards in Coding mode and expanding the active chat workspace in the sidebar now behave correctly.
- Workflow designer graphs are normalized and nodes show their step names.

## ⚙️ Under the Hood
- Upgraded to Electron 44 and remediated dependency audit findings.
- Hardened EV malware-scan validation for signing and removed an unused Azure DevOps PAT constant.
- Application version metadata was bumped to 1.0.19.

🛸 Co-authored with [Nova](https://www.compassap.ai/portfolio/nova.html)
